result.stdout:
RonSijm.RepoGen repository generator

Usage:
  RonSijm.RepoGen.Tool.exe generate --project <project.csproj> [options]

Options:
  --context <name>       DbContext type name when the project contains more than one.
  --designer-project <project.csproj>  Project containing a RepositoryDesigner.
  --designer <name>      RepositoryDesigner type name when the project contains more than one.
  --output <file>        Generated C# file. Defaults to Generated/RonSijm.RepoGen.Repositories.g.cs.
  --projection-output <file>  Generated projection extensions configured by the designer.
  --configuration <name> Build configuration. Defaults to Debug.
  --no-build             Inspect the existing project output without building first.
  --generate-selectors   Always include entity selectors in the generated file.
  --help                 Show this help.
